name: Arathi Highlands
summary: In Arathi, ruined Stromgarde leaves the highlands at war on several fronts. The kingdom's remnants, the Horde, Syndicate nobles, and invading ogres fight for the ancient birthplace of the Empire of Arathor in southeastern Lordaeron.

sections.title: Cradle of Humanity
sections.body:
The dry plains of Arathi once formed the heart of a united human realm. Millennia ago, King Thoradin gathered the divided tribes beneath the Arathi banner and built their capital, Strom, on ground that was easy to defend. During the Troll Wars, humanity made its compact with the high elves here and learned the arcane arts to drive back the Amani.

Noble bloodlines later spread north into Lordaeron and south toward Stormwind. The imperial guard remained and formed Stromgarde, a martial kingdom that guarded the border against forest trolls for ages.

sections.title: A Shattered Kingdom
sections.body:
Under King Thoras Trollbane, Stromgarde helped defend the Alliance during the Second War. The Third War and its aftermath broke the kingdom. It escaped the worst of the Scourge plague, but King Thoras's mysterious death plunged the realm into turmoil. Boulderfist ogres came down from the hills, while nobles of Alterac in the Syndicate seized wide districts of Stromgarde Keep.

Prince Galen Trollbane and his loyalists now hold a small part of the city and their refuge at Refuge Pointe. Against heavy odds, they fight a bitter guerrilla war.

sections.title: The War for the Highlands
sections.body:
Arathi is contested by forces with different claims. In the northeast, the Horde made Hammerfall from an abandoned human internment camp and named it for Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer. The outpost anchors their northern holdings and protects their allies in Hillsbrad. The Witherbark trolls seek vengeance against the humans who once persecuted them, while the Argus Wake guides the Syndicate's occupation.

At the plateau's center, the ancient Circles of Binding hold elementals in place. They restrain an old power buried beneath the stone.

faq.answer: After King Thoras Trollbane died, strife engulfed Stromgarde and attackers closed in. Boulderfist ogres took the outer districts, while the Syndicate seized the keep's sanctum. Prince Galen Trollbane and his dwindling garrison hold one fortified corner and fight for their capital.

Hammerfall is a Horde outpost built in the remains of a human internment camp where orcs were held after the Second War. Its name honors former Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer, who died leading the campaign to free captives from camps across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where does the Alliance operate in Arathi?
faq.answer: Alliance soldiers and Stromgarde defenders operate from Refuge Pointe, a naturally fortified canyon in the center of the highlands. From there, they attack to reclaim Stromgarde Keep and push back ogres and trolls.

faq.q: What are the stone circles across the plains?
faq.answer: The Inner, Outer, East, and West Circles of Binding are ancient magical seals guarded and maintained by rogue elementals. They imprison an unknown, primordial being deep beneath the highlands.

faq.q: How do you reach the Arathi Highlands?
aliases: how to get to arathi highlands
faq.answer: From the north and west, travelers cross the breach in Thoradin's Wall from the Hillsbrad Foothills. From Khaz Modan in the south, they cross the dwarven bridge of the Thandol Span over the chasm between the highlands and the Wetlands.

faq.q: What is the Syndicate doing in Arathi?
faq.answer: The Syndicate is made up of exiled Alteraci nobles who seek new domains by pillaging fallen realms. In Arathi, they have taken large parts of Stromgarde Keep and nearby farms, including Northfold Manor.

angles.text: As a human, you share roots with every kingdom in the Empire of Arathor. Seeing its ancient seat broken and overrun by ogres and thieves is a deep cultural loss.
As a member of the Horde, you know Hammerfall as sacred ground. It honors Orgrim Doomhammer's sacrifice to free an enslaved people from internment.
As a warrior, you follow Stromgarde's celebrated martial tradition. Its rugged battlegrounds are a revered trial by arms.
As a miner, you can find iron and mithril in Arathi's craggy ridges. Drywhisker Gorge is the only known source of lesser bloodstone ore.
